[EN] Ritual of Solace
[ES] Ritual de solaz
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Sure, I can help you."
[ES] "Claro, puedo ayudarte."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Got it."
[ES] "Entendido."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Rhodos.
[ES] Habla con Rhodos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Investigate the First Suspicious Corpse.
[ES] Investiga el primer cadáver sospechoso.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "He didn't see it coming."
[ES] "No lo vio venir."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Investigate the Second Suspicious Corpse.
[ES] Investiga el segundo cadáver sospechoso.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Uh, yeah. We can't have that."
[ES] "Eh, sí. No podemos permitir eso."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Share your findings with Rhodos.
[ES] Comparte tus descubrimientos con Rhodos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Gather soul fragments from the corpses of baraka soldiers.
[ES] Recolecta fragmentos de alma de los cadáveres de los soldados baraka.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill the sheep and gather their blood.
[ES] Mata a las ovejas y recolecta su sangre.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'm anxious to get started."
[ES] "Estoy deseando empezar."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return to Rhodos with the soulstones.
[ES] Regresa con Rhodos con las piedras del alma.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use the soulstones at a {@LinkCreature:181#101#Baraka tombstone} to perform the ritual of solace.
[ES] Usa las piedras del alma en una {@LinkCreature:181#101#lápida baraka} para realizar el ritual de solaz.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You sense that the baraka's soul is at rest.
[ES] Sientes que el alma del baraka está en paz.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Pay your respect at the stone grave using the /sad command.
[ES] Rinde homenaje en la tumba de piedra usando el comando /sad.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'm looking forward to it."
[ES] "Tengo muchas ganas de hacerlo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return to Rhodos.
[ES] Regresa con Rhodos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
